A pipeline: operations (nodes, by id) and the edges between them.

Download the schema for your editor or validator: [pipeline.schema.json](/dsp-kitchen/schemas/pipeline.schema.json).

## The spec

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dspk_pipeline` | `integer` | yes | Spec version; must equal `SPEC_VERSION`. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Free-form name. |
| `nodes` | `object` | yes | Every operation, by node id. |
| `edges` | list of list | yes | `[from, to]` node ids. |
| `execution` | [`Execution`](#execution) |  |  Default: `{"mode": "auto", "chunk_samples": 65536, "upload": "auto"}`. |

## Nodes

A node's `op` says what it is. `read` and `write` are the ends; the others process.

### `read`

The input recording(s): `path` (one file, or a glob such as `sessions/*.bin`, which runs the pipeline once per match) or `inputs` (a list of paths / globs and merges, run one after the other). A merge reads several recordings as one, channels side by side. Relative paths are relative to the spec file. With several inputs the write path needs `{stem}` or `{index}`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` |  |  |
| `inputs` | list of [`Input`](#input) |  |  |
| `source` | `string` |  | Source id within the file (`dspk_io::sources`; with `path` only); default: the file's default source. |
| `channels` | list of `integer` |  | Channels to read, in this order; default: all. |
| `start` | `integer` |  | First sample to process (samples, not seconds, so a range is exact); default: 0. |
| `stop` | `integer` |  | Sample after the last one to process; default: the end of the recording. Halos of window mode may read real data outside `start..stop`. |

### `write`

The output file, float32 whatever the input's stored type (every recording processed by a pipeline comes out in the same form). Relative paths are relative to the spec file.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | yes |  |
| `format` | `"raw"` \| `"zarr"` |  |  Default: `"raw"`. |
| `compression` | [`Compression`](#compression) |  | Zarr only: chunk compression; default zstd level 3 (`dspk_io::DEFAULT_ZARR_COMPRESSION`). Chunks are compressed and stored in parallel. |
| `chunk_samples` | `integer` |  | Zarr only: samples per chunk along time (every chunk spans all channels); default `dspk_io::generic::zarr_traces::DEFAULT_CHUNK_SAMPLES` (5000). |
| `parallel` | `boolean` |  | Write in parallel (Zarr: chunks compressed and stored on several threads; raw: frames built on several threads); default `true`. `false` writes on one thread (e.g. a machine busy with other work, or to compare). |

### `scale`

`y = alpha * x + beta`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alpha` | `number` | yes |  |
| `beta` | `number` |  |  Default: `0.0`. |

### `subtract_baseline`

`y = x - baseline`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseline` | `number` | yes |  |

### `clamp`

`y = clip(x, min, max)`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | `number` | yes |  |
| `max` | `number` | yes |  |

### `rectify`

`y = \|x\|` (full-wave rectification; then a low-pass gives an EMG envelope).

### `square`

`y = x²` (instantaneous power; then a moving average and `sqrt` give a moving RMS).

### `sqrt`

`y = √x`, negative values taken as 0.

### `log10`

`y = log₁₀ \|x\|`, magnitudes below 1e-12 taken as 1e-12.

### `laplacian`

Surface Laplacian of an electrode grid of `[rows, cols]` (channels in row-major order: channel `r · cols + c`): each channel minus the mean of its orthogonal neighbours, which removes what volume conduction spreads over the grid (HD-EMG, ECoG). The chain's channels must number `rows · cols`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grid` | list of `integer` | yes |  |

### `whiten`

Spatial whitening (global ZCA): decorrelates the channels and gives each unit variance, as sorters do before detection. Fitted before the run on the signal the nodes before it produce: `fit_s` seconds in `chunks` chunks spread over the recording; `epsilon` regularises the covariance (in the signal's unit squared).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `epsilon` | `number` |  |  Default: `9.999999974752427e-07`. |
| `fit_s` | `number` |  |  Default: `10.0`. |
| `chunks` | `integer` |  |  Default: `5`. |

### `iir`

IIR filter designed for the recording's sample rate.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `band` | `"lowpass"` \| `"highpass"` \| `"bandpass"` \| `"bandstop"` | yes |  |
| `cutoff` | list of `number` | yes | Hz: one value (lowpass, highpass) or `[low, high]` (bandpass, bandstop). |
| `order` | `integer` |  |  Default: `5`. |
| `design` | `"butterworth"` \| `"chebyshev1"` \| `"bessel"` |  |  Default: `"butterworth"`. |
| `ripple_db` | `number` |  | Pass-band ripple, chebyshev1 only. |
| `mode` | `"forward_backward"` \| `"forward"` |  |  Default: `"forward_backward"`. |
| `start` | `"rest"` \| `"steady_state"` |  |  Default: `"rest"`. |

### `notch`

Second-order notch (`scipy.signal.iirnotch`).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `freq` | `number` | yes |  |
| `q` | `number` | yes |  |
| `mode` | `"forward_backward"` \| `"forward"` |  |  Default: `"forward_backward"`. |
| `start` | `"rest"` \| `"steady_state"` |  |  Default: `"rest"`. |

### `sos`

Explicit second-order sections `[b0, b1, b2, a0, a1, a2]` (scipy layout), already designed for the recording's sample rate.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sections` | list of list of `number` | yes |  |
| `mode` | `"forward_backward"` \| `"forward"` |  |  Default: `"forward_backward"`. |
| `start` | `"rest"` \| `"steady_state"` |  |  Default: `"rest"`. |

### `fir`

FIR filter with explicit `taps` (design them with `dspk.ops.filter.firwin` or scipy): causal, or `centered` (odd number of taps around each sample).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `taps` | list of `number` | yes |  |
| `centered` | `boolean` |  |  Default: `false`. |
| `edge` | `"zeros"` \| `"odd"` \| `"reflect"` \| `"nearest"` |  |  Default: `"zeros"`. |

### `resample`

Resampling by `up / down` (`scipy.signal.resample_poly`: polyphase FIR, Kaiser `beta` window); must be the last node before `write`. The output's sample rate is `rate · up / down`; with a `read` range, its `start` must be a multiple of `down`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `up` | `integer` | yes |  |
| `down` | `integer` | yes |  |
| `beta` | `number` |  |  Default: `5.0`. |
| `edge` | `"zeros"` \| `"odd"` \| `"reflect"` \| `"nearest"` |  |  Default: `"zeros"`. |

### `remap`

Channels reordered, dropped and renamed by pairs, like a hardware channel mapper: `pairs` written here (`base` 0, or 1 for 1-based numbers), or `path` to a map file (`.toml` / `.json` with the pairs under `remap`; relative to the spec file). Output channel `to` reads input `from`; inputs left out are dropped. Right after `read` (or another remap): it folds into the read, at no cost.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base` | `integer` |  |  Default: `0`. |
| `pairs` | list of [`ChannelPair`](#channelpair) |  |  |
| `path` | `string` |  |  |

## Compression

Compression of Zarr chunks: `{"codec": "zstd", "level": 3}`, `{"codec": "blosc_lz4", "level": 5}` (LZ4 after a byte shuffle; faster, usually a little larger) or `{"codec": "none"}`.

- `object`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `codec` | `"none"` | yes |  |

- `object`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `codec` | `"zstd"` | yes |  |
| `level` | `integer` |  |  Default: `3`. |

- `object`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `codec` | `"blosc_lz4"` | yes |  |
| `level` | `integer` |  |  Default: `5`. |

How the executor runs the chain.
